thread:
nora: quick a11y pass on Live Logs viewer this morning — a few SR + keyboard nits I hit during streaming tests :mag:
nora: 1) new log lines are appended but the screen reader doesn't announce them (we append DOM nodes only, no live region)
nora: 2) pause/play control is icon-only with no accessible name; VoiceOver just says "button"
nora: 3) 'Jump to latest' is only exposed as a keyboard shortcut (L). keyboard-only users have no focusable control to reach this action
nora: 4) when I try to arrow through lines the reader skips many entries — log rows are non-focusable divs (tabindex=-1) so NVDA/VO won't land on them

sam: agreed. proposed fixes: add an offscreen aria-live='polite' region that announces short summaries like "3 new log lines" (avoid reading full payloads), and batch updates to reduce spam
sam: make the pause icon a real <button> with aria-label='Pause log stream' and toggle aria-pressed when paused

kai: add a visible toolbar button for 'Jump to latest' with aria-label and title so it's tabbable; keep the L shortcut for power users but don't rely on it alone
kai: convert list to role='list' with each row role='listitem' and use roving tabindex (only one item has tabindex=0). arrow Up/Down should move focus and update a small live region with context (timestamp + severity)

anya: also add a user pref 'Screen reader verbosity' (off | summary | full) so folks can opt into full-line reads if they want. default to summary to avoid overwhelm
a11y-bot: automated scan (live-logs/2026-03-25) — issues flagged: 4 (2 high: missing live region for streaming; icon buttons missing accessible name). Report: https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/3589 :warning:

sam: I'll draft the toolbar changes (Pause + Jump to latest) and the aria-live helper. will include unit tests for keyboard focus and an e2e that tabs into toolbar and uses arrow keys inside the list
kai: i'll implement roving-tabindex util + keyboard handlers and add a small screen-reader acceptance test harness in storybook
nora: i'll own the live-region batching logic and the SR verbosity pref. will add acceptance criteria in the PR: 1) when new lines arrive announce "N new log lines" in polite live region; 2) pause button announced and toggles aria-pressed; 3) Jump button tabbable and announced; 4) arrow keys move focus between log rows and announce timestamp+severity

sam: please link axe scan in PR and tag @eng-accessibility. also include short screen recordings for QA smoke test (NVDA/VoiceOver)

anya: one visual nit — ensure focused row in high-contrast has a 3px outline and subtle background tint so keyboard users can clearly spot focus. tag @design for visual review on PRs

nora: opening tickets now and will post PR links here. closing thread after PRs are up.
